items.question: From what age can children receive the Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine in the UAE?
items.gold: Pfizer vaccine can be given to children from the age of 12 years.
items.fact: Pfizer COVID-19 vaccine for children starts at age 12.

items.question: How many months after the initial single dose can a person vaccinated with Janssen receive a COVID-19 booster in the UAE?
items.gold: After 2 months from the initial single dose.
items.fact: Janssen COVID-19 booster given 2 months after initial dose.
